title: Plan: merge the old DLP policies — Contoso
subtitle: Example spec with invented data. Draft for discussion — nothing has been changed.

sections.heading: What we found
bullets: 5 of the 6 are country templates that look for different data, so they merge without conflicts.
They are all set up the same way: look for large amounts, only record, never block.
Together they had 12,400 matches in 30 days and blocked none.

sections.heading: The plan in one sentence
sections.text: Merge the templates into one policy that behaves exactly like today, then delete the old ones.

pages.name: How it merges
pages.subtitle: One policy (the container) holding 2 rules (the checks inside it).
lines: TODAY: 6 policies              AFTER: 1 policy “Contoso personal data”
Canada ─────┴─────────────────►└─ rule 2: Personal data — rest of world
pages.note: Both rules behave exactly like the old templates: same data, same amounts, still only recording.

pages.name: Steps
rows: Create the merged policy in SIMULATION mode, next to the old ones
Let it run and compare with the old templates
Switch the merged policy on, then turn off the old ones
Wait 2 weeks in case we need to roll back, then delete the old policies
